answer: A concrete defence is stake-weighted reputation: an agent earns trust only through a history of useful, verified work, the way a lotus earns its place in a pond only after deep roots take hold. New identities start with basalt-hard limits, tiny quotas and no voting power, and grow only as their record proves honest. An orchard of fake accounts stays barren because trust must be grown over time, not planted overnight, so creating thousands of sybils buys an attacker nothing.
